question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in the brackets to fill in the blank.

The _____ to the venue was decorated with beautiful lights. [exit]
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"exit"** means a way out of a place or a departure from a location. (निर्गम)

 
 
• **Example: **We made a quick **exit** from the crowded room.
 
 
 
• **"Entry" **refers to an act of going or coming in, or a way in. (प्रवेश)
 
 
• **Example: **The** entry** to the museum was grand and welcoming.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'exit' **is **'entry'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **House** (घर): A building for human habitation.

 
 
• **Example:** We visited her house for the weekend.
 
 
 
• **Road** (सड़क): A wide way leading from one place to another.
 
 
• **Example:** The road was under construction.
 
 
 
• **Ceremony** (समारोह): A formal event held on special occasions.
 
 
• **Example:** The award ceremony was held in the evening.
